skill.name: Battle Song
skill.description: Increases the critical hit chance for all allies that have that stat for 5 seconds.

skill.name: Striking Solo
skill.description: Ally critical hits deal extra pure damage while they are affected by Battle Song.
skill.extraPureDamageFormula: (0.12% Physical attack + 0.2 * Level + 4)% of crit damage

skill.name: Public Idol
skill.description: Sebastian enters combat with additional starting Energy.

skill.name: Totem of Wrath
skill.description: Creates a totem that fires magic charges at the enemy team for 6 seconds. Mojo cannot attack or use skills during this time.

skill.name: Healing Spirits
skill.description: Heals each ally.

skill.name: Cursed Bones
skill.description: Throws a charge at the nearest enemy, dealing magic damage and stunning the target, then bouncing to random enemies.

skill.name: Hex
skill.description: Marks a random target at the start of combat. Every 2 seconds, the mark deals magic damage based on how much damage the target received.

skill.name: Deathflower
skill.description: Summons a huge mushroom at the center of the enemy team which spreads toxic spores, poisoning all enemies in the area.

ascension.name: Suffocating Deathflower
ascension.description: The Deathflower deals 10% more poison damage every 0.5 seconds to affected targets.

skill.name: Toxic Spit
skill.description: Shoots the nearest enemy with a dart, poisoning them.

skill.name: Snake Charmer
skill.description: Throws a snake at the rival with the lowest health which bites the rival, dealing pure damage.

skill.name: Spy Camo
skill.description: If Heidi isn't damaged for 2 seconds, he receives camouflage that gradually increases his dodge chance.

ascension.name: Deadly Spy Camo
ascension.description: While camouflaged, Heidi deals extra skill damage that increases gradually.

skill.name: Torment of Powerlessness
skill.description: Jorgen summons a Skull to the enemy's front line which deals magic damage to nearby heroes and prevents affected enemies from gaining energy.

skill.name: Cycle of Energies
skill.description: Protects an ally with a magic shield that doubles their energy gain until the shield is destroyed.

skill.name: Leper
skill.description: Curses the entire enemy team, redirecting physical damage taken by all enemies to the furthest enemy.

skill.name: Tainted Wounds
skill.description: With every attack, Jorgen steals energy from the affected enemy.

skill.name: Hydrokinesis
skill.description: Summons a powerful downpour that deals magic damage per second for 6 seconds. Enemies receive reduced healing and cannot be resurrected.

skill.name: Tidal Wave
skill.description: Transforms into an unstoppable wave that surges through enemies, dealing magic damage and scattering them. Cascade returns to his initial position afterward.

skill.name: Refluence
skill.description: When returning from Tidal Wave, Cascade applies Water Mark to enemies for 5 seconds. Marked enemies take additional magic damage whenever they are hit by magic.

skill.name: Elemental Surge
skill.description: Empowers allied Intelligence heroes. Their basic attacks deal bonus magic damage based on their magic attack.
skill.notes: Does not apply if the hero already deals magic damage with basic attacks.

skill.name: Deal with the Devil
skill.description: Hellfire envelops all allied Heroes for 12 seconds. Allies become immune to damage from enemy basic attacks and reflect that damage back.

skill.name: To Hell and Back
skill.description: Baalthazar protects all allies from death for 10 seconds. Allies who die during this time are resurrected when the effect ends.

skill.name: Mark of Death
skill.description: Fluffy gains Marks of Death, increasing his magic armor penetration. When Fluffy dies, all Marks explode and deal damage to enemies.

skill.name: Usurpation
skill.description: When an enemy uses an ultimate ability, Fluffy cancels it and deals damage to them. Fluffy takes self‑damage based on his max Health.
skill.notes: Chance to cancel reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Total Destruction
skill.description: Fires 6 magic missiles at the enemies with the highest health.

skill.name: Magnetic Field
skill.description: Creates an explosion in the enemy back line, dealing area damage and slowing enemies for 4 seconds.
skill.notes: Chance to slow reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Antimatter Blast
skill.description: Fires a magic missile at the nearest enemy, stunning them for 4 seconds and dealing magic damage.
skill.notes: Chance to stun reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Full Charge
skill.description: Passive skill. Orion receives additional energy with each attack.

skill.name: Weight of Knowledge
skill.description: Creates a Blot above the enemy team that grows for 5 seconds and deals damage depending on channeling time.

skill.name: Mind Stealer
skill.description: Steals Intelligence from the enemy with the highest Intelligence for 15 seconds.

skill.name: Inky Friends
skill.description: Creates two Ink Copies in the allies' ranks.
skill.copyStats: Same Health, Armor, Magic Defense as Folio’s base stats

skill.name: Superior Copying
skill.description: Passive skill. After Ink Copies expire, Folio trades places and Health with the healthiest Copy.
skill.swapCondition: Trades places with Copy that has most Health left
skill.stayCondition: If Folio has more Health, he stays in place
skill.deathCondition: If Folio dies while Copies are active, he revives by swapping with healthiest Copy

skill.name: Lead Storm
skill.description: Quickly fires 7 buckshot rounds from the pistol, damaging all enemies.

skill.name: Penetrating Shot
skill.description: Fires a missile that penetrates the enemy and hits the enemy directly behind them.

skill.name: Suppressive Fire
skill.description: Shoots in the air, damaging the whole enemy team with buckshot.

skill.name: Ranging Shot
skill.description: Each consecutive shot with the basic attack deals extra physical damage. If the current target dies, the extra damage resets.

skill.name: Big Badda Boom!
skill.description: Throws a bomb at the center of the enemy team. The explosion deals damage, sets enemies on fire for 7 seconds, and pushes them away.

skill.name: Discharge!
skill.description: Electrocutes the nearest enemy, dealing damage. The target and nearby enemies are stunned for 1 second and slowed for 3 seconds.
skill.notes: Chance to stun/slow reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Firefight
skill.description: Fires an incendiary shell at the nearest enemy, dealing damage and setting them and nearby enemies on fire for 5 seconds.

skill.name: Thirst for Blood
skill.description: Daredevil ignores a portion of the armor of enemies she has set on fire.

skill.name: Power of the Tombs
skill.description: Activates an ancient relic: all enemies take damage, and allies under the relic’s effect restore health.

ascension.name: Power of the Sacred Tombs
ascension.description: If Lara Croft lands a critical hit with a basic attack, her next basic attack fires 4 shots.

skill.name: Critical Thinking
skill.description: Focuses for 6 seconds, increasing critical hit chance and critical hit damage.

ascension.name: Absolute Critical Thinking
ascension.description: While active, Lara Croft will land critical hits against stunned enemies.

skill.name: Steady Shot
skill.description: Fires an explosive arrow at the central enemy. All enemies in the explosion radius take damage and are stunned.

skill.name: Lost Knowledge
skill.description: Passive: Every time Lara’s Jade Necklace activates, a random artifact bonus is added for 9 seconds.
skill.possibleBonuses: magic attack, armor, magic defense, armor penetration, magic penetration, critical hit chance, dodge
skill.bonusScaling: Bonus scales with artifact level and ability level.

skill.name: Expedition Expert
skill.description: Triples Lara Croft’s total power in expeditions and grants the player an extra expedition per day.
skill.notes: This skill has no effect in regular battles.

skill.name: Black Arrows
skill.description: Dark Star fires a volley of arrows at the enemy team, dealing damage to all enemies.

skill.name: Control
skill.description: Charms the nearest enemy for 3 seconds, forcing them to attack their own team.
skill.notes: Chance to charm reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Multishot
skill.description: Dark Star fires multiple arrows at the nearest enemy, dealing damage.

skill.name: Wild Hunger
skill.description: Dark Star steals a portion of the Physical attack of the enemy she charms.

skill.name: Lord of the Storm
skill.description: Lars summons a storm at the enemy backline, dragging heroes to its center and applying a Mark of Water.
skill.notes: Drag effect and chance to apply Mark reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Chain Lightning
skill.description: Launches an electrical charge that jumps from enemy to enemy.

skill.name: Lightning Bolt
skill.description: Strikes the nearest enemy with lightning, dealing damage and stunning for 4 seconds. Prioritizes enemies with Mark of Water.
skill.notes: Chance to stun reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Conductance
skill.description: All of Lars’ attacks against enemies with a Mark of Water deal extra damage and stun longer.

skill.name: Lightning Rod
skill.description: Deals magic damage to the enemy with the highest health.

skill.name: Path of Least Resistance
skill.description: Passive skill. Basic attacks deal magic damage and always target the enemy with the least Magic Defense.
skill.targeting: Targets enemy with lowest Magic Defense
skill.silenceImmunity: Being silenced does not disable this skill

skill.name: Grounded
skill.description: Whenever Augustus deals damage with Lightning Rod or his basic attack, all nearby enemies take a percentage of that damage.
skill.notes: Damage decreases with distance

skill.name: Superconductivity
skill.description: Augustus applies Superconductivity whenever he deals damage, decreasing the target's Magic Defense for 6 seconds.
skill.stacking: Effect can be applied multiple times; each application refreshes all stacks
skill.pureDamageCondition: If magic damage fully penetrates Magic Defense, target takes pure damage

skill.name: Go for it, Lucas!
skill.description: Astrid gains rage with each attack. At 100% rage, Lucas transforms into rage form, jumps to the front line, takes enemy attacks without taking damage, and attacks the nearest enemy until rage is depleted.
skill.notes: Lucas takes no damage from attacks while enraged; reverts to passive form when rage reaches 0.

skill.name: Rampant Nature
skill.description: Increases Astrid’s attack and skill speed for 9 seconds. If Lucas is in rage form, the bonus applies to him instead.
skill.notes: Lucas also receives the buff when transforming into rage form. Buff interactions can overlap or stack depending on timing.

skill.name: Predator's Charge
skill.description: Passive skill. While Lucas is in rage form, each consecutive attack increases his damage.

skill.name: Tracker's Mark
skill.description: Each of Astrid’s attacks marks the enemy for 4 seconds. If Lucas hits a marked enemy, the enemy is stunned.
skill.stunEffect: Stuns marked enemies when hit by Lucas
skill.notes: Chance to stun reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Phoenix's Embrace
skill.description: Aidan casts a shield on himself and the farthest ally. The shield absorbs all damage for 5 seconds. When the ally’s shield expires, it explodes, dealing magic damage and applying Phoenix Glyph.

skill.name: Ignite
skill.description: Casts Phoenix Glyph on the nearest enemy without a Glyph. If all enemies already have a Glyph, Aidan releases sparks from the nearest enemy, damaging nearby foes.

skill.name: Inner Fire
skill.description: Aidan unleashes a fire wave healing all allies except himself. He regenerates health every 2 seconds, increasing the next wave’s healing. Below 30% health he self‑ignites, doubling regen until he reaches 60%.

skill.name: Bonds of Flame
skill.description: Creates a mutual bond with the farthest ally (or Kayla if present). The bonded ally becomes the target of Phoenix’s Embrace. Both heroes share health and gain bonuses scaling with Armor and Magic Defense.
skill.defenseBonus: Scales with Armor and Magic Defense

skill.name: Expose Soul
skill.description: Iris exposes an unprotected part of the Soul in the nearest enemy’s body for 13 seconds. All damage dealt to the Soul is transferred to the owner as pure damage.

skill.name: Otherworldly Creature
skill.description: Summons a familiar next to the farthest enemy. The familiar walks back to Iris, biting enemies along the way. Each bite deals more damage than the previous one.

skill.name: Demonic Synergy
skill.description: When the familiar returns to Iris, she gains Soul Fury charges based on successful attacks. Each charge boosts her next basic attack.

skill.name: Seed of Destruction
skill.description: Iris absorbs part of all enemies’ health and launches a Seed of Destruction at the nearest enemy, dealing physical damage equal to the total absorbed health.

skill.name: Heavy Wisdom
skill.description: Hits the enemy with the highest Intelligence using a monolith. Damage scales with the target’s Intelligence.

skill.name: Rune of Suppression
skill.description: Hits the enemy with the highest Magic Attack and reduces their Magic Attack for 12 seconds.

skill.name: Protective Dome
skill.description: Casts a barrier on the team, increasing their Magic Defense for 6 seconds.

skill.name: Memory Loss
skill.description: Curses a random enemy at the beginning of battle, reducing the level of their first skill. Curse disappears if Cornelius dies.

skill.name: Doppelganger
skill.description: Faceless transforms into the ally or enemy who last used their first skill and immediately uses that skill.
skill.notes: - Some skills have no effect when copied (e.g., Astrid & Lucas, Jet). - Passive skills retain their original level (e.g., Maya’s Queen’s Revenge). - 14 heroes have significantly weaker copied skills.

skill.name: Power Throw
skill.description: Raises the nearest enemy into the air and throws them into the center of their team, dealing damage and stunning all enemies in range.
skill.notes: Chance to stun reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Arc Lightning
skill.description: Throws a ricocheting magic missile that hits 3 enemies, dealing damage and reducing their physical attack for 4 seconds.

skill.name: Spell Expert
skill.description: Passive skill. Increases the entire team’s magic defense.

skill.name: Heavy Caliber
skill.description: Fires a huge projectile at the nearest target, dealing physical damage and throwing the target back.

skill.name: Smoke Screen
skill.description: Fires a smoke grenade into the enemy's front row, blinding nearby heroes for 6 seconds.
skill.extraEffect: Heavy Caliber also blinds the enemy’s front row
skill.notes: Chance to blind lowered if target level > 130.

skill.name: Cannonade
skill.description: Shoots the nearest target 6 times.

skill.name: Concussion
skill.description: Passive skill. Heavy Caliber stuns the target for 5 seconds.
skill.notes: Chance to stun lowered if target level > 130.

skill.name: Enchantment
skill.description: Charms all enemies, putting them to sleep for 7 seconds.
skill.wakeCondition: Sleeping enemies wake immediately when damaged by anyone except Lian.
skill.notes: Charm chance lowered if target level > 130.

skill.name: Hypnotic Ball
skill.description: Fires a magical ball at the nearest enemies, then brings it back, dealing pure damage on the way.
skill.notes: Ball stays at the nearest enemies and deals 5× pure damage in a small area. Displayed value is total damage.

skill.name: Wandering Lights
skill.description: Creates 5 magical spheres and launches them at the nearest enemy, dealing magic damage.

skill.name: Conciliation
skill.description: Passive skill. When Lian is damaged, the hero who dealt the damage is charmed for 4 seconds.
skill.notes: Charm chance lowered if target level > 130.

skill.name: Paralysis
skill.description: Inflicts a paralysis curse on the enemy with the highest Physical Attack.

skill.name: Trembling Hands
skill.description: Deals damage to the nearest enemy and curses them, reducing Physical Attack for 3 seconds.
skill.notes: Curse chance decreases if target level > 130.

skill.name: Dark Deal
skill.description: Deals magic damage to the nearest enemy and heals the ally with the lowest health by the same amount.

skill.name: Bound by Fear
skill.description: Paralysis causes the enemy to lose energy and suffer extra damage.

skill.name: Deadly Shower
skill.description: Artemis launches a barrage of shots, striking enemies with a rain of arrows.

ascension.name: Resurgent Deadly Shower
ascension.description: When Deadly Shower is triggered, Artemis fires 7 more arrows.

skill.name: Smart Arrow
skill.description: Fires an arrow at the nearest target that deals damage and bounces to random enemies several times.

ascension.name: Healing Smart Arrow
ascension.description: Smart Arrow bounces 2 more times, then returns to Artemis, healing her.

skill.name: True Light
skill.description: Creates a flash of light that deals damage to all enemies caught in it and blinds them.
skill.notes: Chance to blind lowered if target level > 130.

skill.name: Punishing Arrows
skill.description: Passive skill. For each 10,000 damage taken, Artemis gains a physical attack bonus.

skill.name: Fountain of Blood
skill.description: Casts a blood mark on the nearest rival for 7 seconds. Allies heal whenever they attack the marked enemy.

skill.name: Ancestors' Amulet
skill.description: Dorian sacrifices part of his current health and heals the ally with the lowest health.

skill.name: Wings of Night
skill.description: Releases bats that hit opponents twice. When they return, Dorian heals for 100% of the damage dealt.

skill.name: Initiation
skill.description: Increases Vampirism of nearby allies.

skill.name: Pulsing Comet
skill.description: Attacks the most distant enemy with a Pulsing Comet that deals AoE damage and moves toward the front line. The comet explodes three times: at start, mid‑way, and near its destination. If cast again, the comet stops and releases all remaining pulses at once.

skill.name: Glacial Fortress
skill.description: Creates an ice barrier that withstands three hits. Each hit grants Polaris 10% bonus energy and slows the attacker for 3 seconds. After the third hit, the barrier explodes, dealing AoE damage.

skill.name: Northern Lights
skill.description: Unleashes Northern Lights on enemies. Allies’ control effects last longer on affected foes. Also reduces the level of enemy skills that have a chance to activate.

skill.name: True Freeze
skill.description: When Pulsing Comet or Glacial Fortress explodes, affected enemies receive True Freeze for 3 seconds. Frozen enemies are stunned, cannot gain energy or resources, take increased magic damage, and reduced physical damage.

skill.name: Masquerade
skill.description: Deals magic damage to each rival, stunning, blinding or slowing them for 6 seconds.
skill.notes: Chance to inflict an effect lowered if target level > 130.

ascension.name: Reckless Masquerade
ascension.description: When Peppy uses Masquerade effects, an enemy always takes magic damage.
ascension.extraEffect: If an enemy evades a Masquerade effect, it is applied again (max 3 times).

skill.name: Boldness
skill.description: Casts a shield sphere on an ally for 4 seconds. First shield appears 3 seconds into battle.

ascension.name: Spirit of Boldness
ascension.description: Shielded ally takes reduced damage.

skill.name: Frolic
skill.description: Casts a beam that damages and stuns the nearest rival for 3 seconds.
skill.notes: Chance to stun lowered if target level > 130.

skill.name: Trickster
skill.description: Passive skill. Frolic gains a chance to deal double or quadruple damage.

skill.name: Elixir of Vigor
skill.description: Jet channels a life‑giving elixir to the ally with the highest Physical attack and begins slowly spending energy. As long as the channel continues, the ally gains Physical attack, +30% speed, and Health regeneration.

skill.name: Acid Shot
skill.description: Jet shoots acid at the enemy with the highest Armor, reducing their Armor for 8 seconds.

skill.name: Potion of Fatigue
skill.description: Jet throws a poisoned potion at nearby enemies. Affected enemies cannot regenerate Health for 8 seconds.
skill.effectChanceNote: Chance lowered for enemies above level 130

skill.name: Inordinate Fury
skill.description: Passive skill. While Jet is alive, all allies gain increased critical hit chance.

skill.name: Solar Sanctuary
skill.description: Thea’s healing light reaches all allies and restores their health.

ascension.name: Blessed Solar Sanctuary
ascension.description: Any healing from Solar Sanctuary that exceeds an ally’s max health becomes a shield absorbing all damage.

skill.name: Healing Beam
skill.description: Thea heals the ally with the lowest current health.

ascension.name: Radiant Healing Beam
ascension.description: After Healing Beam, the healed ally takes 50% less damage for 5 seconds.

skill.name: Vow of Silence
skill.description: Applies Silence to enemies for 3 seconds and deals magic damage.
skill.notes: Chance reduced if target level > 130.

skill.name: Second Wind
skill.description: Passive skill. Increases ally speed when their health drops below 30%.

skill.name: Blacksmith Mastery
skill.description: Stuns all enemies for 2 seconds and grants the Runic Blade effect to all allies. If an ally is protected by a Runic Shield, all allies receive the same shield effect.
skill.notes: Chance to stun lowered if target level > 130.

skill.name: Runic Shield
skill.description: Fafnir targets a random ally (Agility heroes prioritized) and forges a Runic Shield using his basic attacks. Shield durability increases with each hit and activates when the ally drops below 25% health. The shield absorbs all damage and prevents lethal damage once per battle.

skill.name: Runic Blade
skill.description: Enchants the weapon of the ally currently receiving a Runic Shield, increasing physical attack damage for 8 seconds. Honor heroes gain double bonus when attacking Strength‑based enemies.

skill.name: Knowledge of Flaws
skill.description: When an allied hero stuns an enemy, Fafnir applies a Seal that boosts Armor Penetration for 10 seconds. Re‑stunning resets the duration. Bonus stacks up to 5 times.

skill.name: Star Birth
skill.description: Helios directs 3 new and all existing solar spheres to the frontline of the enemy team, where they explode and deal area damage.

skill.name: Solar Wind
skill.description: Summons an invulnerable flaming sphere that deals damage over time to nearby enemies for 10 seconds.

skill.name: Celestial Guardians
skill.description: Summons 2 protection spheres at the center of your team. These spheres absorb physical damage dealt to nearby allies.

skill.name: Flaming Retribution
skill.description: While Solar Wind is active, each time Helios’ allies are critically hit, the flaming sphere may retaliate with a fire beam that damages the attacker.
skill.condition: Requires Solar Wind to be active

skill.name: Underworld Seal
skill.description: Casts an Underworld Seal under the central enemy and detonates it, damaging the target and nearby enemies.

ascension.name: Stunning Underworld Seal
ascension.description: The enemy that takes the least damage from Underworld Seal is stunned for 5 seconds.

skill.name: Infernal Rift
skill.description: Conjures an Infernal Rift below the central enemy, dealing magic damage to the target and nearby enemies.

skill.name: Fire Breath
skill.description: Lilith launches a Tainted Fireball at the central enemy. The fireball explodes, decreasing Magic Defense of enemies in the area.

skill.name: Possession
skill.description: When Lilith has sufficient health, she sacrifices 5% of her max health before using each skill, increasing her Magic Attack by the amount sacrificed for 5 seconds.

ascension.name: Mass Possession
ascension.description: When Possession triggers, enemies weakened by Fire Breath take pure damage equal to 1% of their max health (capped), boosting Lilith’s Magic Attack by the damage dealt.

skill.name: Foremother's Oath
skill.description: Increases all allies' speed for 6 seconds.

skill.name: Secret of Longevity
skill.description: Martha’s basic attacks heal her when a projectile hits an enemy. The farther the projectile travels, the more health it restores.

skill.name: Tea Party
skill.description: Conjures a totem in front of Martha that restores allies' health. Enemies cannot target the totem, but it can take AoE damage.

skill.name: Healing Brew
skill.description: While the totem is active, the ally with the least health receives additional healing.
